responsibility: This file implements the OpenACC worker neutering/broadcast pass used for device offloading after OpenACC lowering. It analyzes partitioned regions and loop structure in offloaded functions, splits CFG blocks around OpenACC fork/join and related internal markers, computes which statements must execute in redundant versus single-worker modes, creates and uses worker-broadcast records for propagating values across lanes/workers, accounts for gang-private and reduction shared-memory layout, and rewrites the function body so worker-partitioned execution follows the target’s OpenACC execution model.
